data.text: Damages all known creatures at once.

logic.description: Implemented point-buy damage to EVERYONE within 10 hexes of the caster — the caster, allies and enemies alike (pc ruling; invisible units are hit too — untargeted area, ruling 2026-11-14). One die per emission (Earth→Matter, Concentration→Will, Space→World), Σ kept ÷10 rounded half up per victim; shields per element apply per victim. No target is chosen. A failed roll re-emits only that element.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: Rule 20: one point-buy per emission on the caster stat behind the element going out; this is the total number of d6 the whole cast rolls (6·n nearest the stat, ties to more dice).
Σ of the kept dice (one per element, the highest die of each successful roll) ÷10, rounded half up; a failed roll re-emits only that element (cast status retry).
Every living unit within this many hexes of the caster is hit, caster included.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_earth (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
